name: s
description: Plays samples or synths by name, one event per word of the mini-notation.

name: note
description: Sets the pitch of each event, with note names like c3 or eb2, or MIDI numbers.

name: n
description: Chooses a sample variant by number, or a scale degree when followed by scale().

name: bank
description: Plays the sounds from a drum machine bank: s("bd").bank("MotifKit") plays MotifKit_bd.

name: stack
description: Plays several patterns at the same time.

name: cat
description: Plays patterns one after the other, one pattern per cycle.

name: silence
description: A pattern without any event. Useful as a placeholder.

name: setcpm
description: Sets the tempo in cycles per minute. With 4 beats per cycle, setcpm(120/4) is 120 BPM.

name: setcps
description: Sets the tempo in cycles per second. setcps(0.5) plays one cycle every two seconds.

name: fast
description: Speeds the pattern up: fast(2) plays it twice per cycle.

name: slow
description: Slows the pattern down: slow(2) stretches it over two cycles.

name: rev
description: Plays each cycle backwards.

name: ply
description: Repeats every event inside its own time: ply(2) doubles each note.

name: early
description: Shifts the pattern earlier in time, by a fraction of a cycle.

name: late
description: Shifts the pattern later in time, by a fraction of a cycle.

name: hurry
description: Speeds the pattern up and raises the pitch of samples by the same factor.

name: iter
description: Starts the pattern one division later every cycle, so it rotates over n cycles.

name: euclid
description: Spreads a number of pulses as evenly as possible over a number of steps.

name: struct
description: Gives the pattern the rhythm of a pattern of x and ~.

name: mask
description: Silences the parts of the pattern where the mask is 0 or ~.

name: chop
description: Cuts each sample into equal parts and plays them in order.

name: striate
description: Cuts the samples into parts and interleaves the parts of every sample.

name: slice
description: Cuts the sample into equal slices and plays them in the order given by the index pattern.

name: loopAt
description: Changes the sample speed so it lasts the given number of cycles. The pitch changes with the speed.

name: begin
description: Starts sample playback at a position between 0 (start) and 1 (end).

name: end
description: Stops sample playback at a position between 0 (start) and 1 (end).

name: degradeBy
description: Removes events at random. degradeBy(0.3) drops about 30% of them.

name: degrade
description: Removes about half of the events at random.

name: sometimes
description: Applies a function to about half of the events, chosen at random.

name: often
description: Applies a function to about 75% of the events, chosen at random.

name: rarely
description: Applies a function to about 25% of the events, chosen at random.

name: lastOf
description: Applies a function on the last cycle of every group of n cycles.

name: firstOf
description: Applies a function on the first cycle of every group of n cycles.

name: chunk
description: Divides the cycle into parts and applies a function to one part per cycle, in turn.

name: jux
description: Plays the original pattern in the left ear and a transformed version in the right ear. An instant way to add stereo width.

name: juxBy
description: Like jux, with a width between 0 (both in the middle) and 1 (fully left and right).

name: pan
description: Places the sound between left (0), center (0.5) and right (1).

name: superimpose
description: Plays a transformed copy of the pattern on top of the original.

name: off
description: Adds a transformed copy of the pattern, shifted later by a fraction of a cycle.

name: scale
description: Turns the numbers of n() into notes of a scale, written as root:type, like C:minor.

name: transpose
description: Shifts notes up or down by a number of semitones.

name: arp
description: Plays the notes of each chord one at a time, in the order of the index pattern.

name: gain
description: Sets the volume. 1 is the default, 0 is silent.

name: velocity
description: Scales the volume of each event between 0 and 1, like how hard a key or pad is hit.

name: lpf
description: Low-pass filter: keeps the frequencies below the cutoff, in Hz. Lower values sound darker.

name: lpq
description: Resonance of the low-pass filter: higher values boost the cutoff frequency.

name: hpf
description: High-pass filter: keeps the frequencies above the cutoff, in Hz. Higher values sound thinner.

name: room
description: Adds reverb, between 0 and 1. The reverb is shared by all sounds of the same orbit.

name: size
description: Size of the reverb room: larger values give a longer tail. Also written roomsize.

name: delay
description: Adds echoes, between 0 and 1. The delay is shared by all sounds of the same orbit.

name: delaytime
description: Time between two echoes of the delay, in seconds.

name: delayfeedback
description: How much of each echo is fed back, between 0 and 1: more feedback, more repeats.

name: shape
description: Saturates the sound with waveshaping distortion, between 0 and 1.

name: crush
description: Reduces the bit depth, from 16 (clean) down to 1 (very harsh).

name: speed
description: Changes the playback speed of samples: 2 is an octave up, negative values play backwards.

name: attack
description: Time the sound takes to reach full volume, in seconds.

name: release
description: Time the sound takes to fade out after the note ends, in seconds.

name: sine
description: A signal that goes smoothly from 0 to 1 and back once per cycle. Use it as the value of a parameter.

name: perlin
description: A signal that wanders smoothly and randomly between 0 and 1.

name: range
description: Scales a signal from 0..1 to min..max, for example a filter sweep between 300 and 1200 Hz.

name: seq
short: one after the other in a cycle
description: Plays its patterns one after the other, all squeezed into a single cycle, like words in the mini-notation.

name: polymeter
description: Lines up the steps of several patterns and repeats each one until they fit together, which makes polymeters: three steps against two, five against four.

name: arrange
description: Plays sections one after the other, each for its number of cycles, then starts again. Motif writes the song this way.

name: pick
description: Uses a pattern of numbers to pick patterns from a list: 0 plays the first, 1 the second, and so on.

name: run
description: A pattern of the numbers from 0 to n-1 in one cycle, handy for scales and slices.

name: segment
description: Samples a continuous pattern, like a signal, n times per cycle, turning it into separate events.

name: palindrome
description: Plays the pattern forwards, then backwards on the next cycle, and so on.

name: inside
description: Slows the pattern down by the factor, applies the function, then speeds it back up, so the function works on a smaller scale.

name: outside
description: Speeds the pattern up by the factor, applies the function, then slows it back down, so the function works across several cycles.

name: linger
description: Keeps only the first part of each cycle (a half, a quarter...) and repeats it to fill the cycle.

name: zoom
description: Plays only part of each cycle, between begin and end (0 to 1), stretched over the whole cycle.

name: compress
description: Squeezes each cycle into the span between begin and end (0 to 1) and leaves silence around it.

name: bite
description: Cuts each cycle of a pattern into slices and plays them in the order of a pattern of slice numbers. Like slice, for patterns instead of samples.

name: euclidRot
description: An euclidean rhythm shifted by a number of steps, for example the samba rhythm euclidRot(3, 16, 14).

name: euclidLegato
description: Like euclid, but each pulse lasts until the next one, with no gaps.

name: brak
description: Every other cycle, plays the pattern twice as fast and a quarter cycle late, for a breakbeat feel.

name: press
description: Moves each event halfway into its step, which syncopates the rhythm.

name: swingBy
description: Cuts each cycle into slices and delays the second half of each slice by the amount (0 to 1), for a shuffle.

name: swing
description: Shorthand for swingBy(1/3, subdivision): the classic shuffle.

name: invert
description: Swaps the 1s and 0s of a rhythm made of 1 and 0, so what played becomes silent and the other way round.

name: when
description: Applies the function while a pattern of 1 and 0 is at 1.

name: someCyclesBy
description: Applies the function to whole cycles, chosen at random with the given probability.

name: sometimesBy
description: Applies the function to events chosen at random, with the given probability (0 to 1).

name: almostNever
description: Applies the function to about one event in ten, chosen at random.

name: almostAlways
description: Applies the function to about nine events in ten, chosen at random.

name: rand
description: A continuous random value between 0 and 1, different at every moment. Use it with range, like any signal.

name: irand
description: A continuous random whole number from 0 to n-1, for picking notes or samples at random.

name: choose
description: Picks one of the given values at random for each event.

name: chooseCycles
short: a pattern per cycle at random
description: Plays one of the given patterns, chosen at random for each cycle.

name: wchoose
description: Picks values at random, each with its own weight, so some come up more often.

name: shuffle
description: Cuts each cycle into parts and plays them in a random order, each part exactly once.

name: scramble
description: Cuts each cycle into parts and plays parts at random: some may repeat, some may be left out.

name: undegradeBy
description: The other half of degradeBy: keeps exactly the events degradeBy would remove.

name: saw
description: A signal that rises from 0 to 1 over each cycle, then jumps back to 0. Motif calls it Ramp.

name: isaw
description: A signal that falls from 1 to 0 over each cycle. Motif calls it Reverse ramp.

name: tri
description: A signal that rises from 0 to 1 then falls back over each cycle, in straight lines.

name: square
description: A signal that is 0 for the first half of each cycle and 1 for the second half.

name: cosine
description: A sine signal shifted by a quarter cycle: it starts at its highest point.

name: rangex
description: Like range, but follows an exponential curve, which sounds more even for frequencies.

name: add
description: Adds a number, or a pattern of numbers, to every value: degrees, notes or any number.

name: sub
description: Subtracts a number, or a pattern of numbers, from every value.

name: mul
description: Multiplies every value by a number, or a pattern of numbers.

name: chord
description: Chord symbols such as C, Am, Fm7 or G7. Follow with voicing() to turn them into notes.

name: voicing
description: Turns chord symbols into notes that move smoothly from one chord to the next.

name: rootNotes
description: Replaces each chord symbol by its root note in the given octave, for a bass line.

name: vowel
description: A formant filter that makes sounds say a vowel: a, e, i, o, u, and a few more.
example: note("c2 eb2").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u>")

name: coarse
description: Fakes a lower sample rate: 1 is unchanged, 2 half the rate, and so on, for a crunchy sound.

name: distort
description: Wave-shaping distortion; values between 0 and 10 are the most useful. It can get loud.

name: postgain
description: Volume applied after every effect, useful after distortion. Motif uses it for the volume automation of the master.

name: hpq
description: The resonance of the high-pass filter, from 0 to 50.

name: bpf
description: A band-pass filter: keeps the frequencies around the given one, in hertz.

name: phaser
description: A sweeping phaser effect, like a guitar pedal; the value is the speed of the sweep.

name: vib
description: Wobbles the pitch of synths at the given speed, in hertz.

name: orbit
description: Sends the pattern to a numbered bus: patterns on the same orbit share reverb and delay. Motif gives every track its own orbit.

name: decay
description: How long the sound takes, after the attack, to fall to the sustain level.

name: sustain
description: The level, from 0 to 1, the sound holds after the decay until the note ends.

name: clip
description: Multiplies how long each note lasts, and cuts samples that would go beyond it.

name: cut
description: Stops a playing sample when another sample of the same cut group starts, like an open hi-hat cut by a closed one.

name: splice
description: Like slice, but each slice is sped up or slowed down to fill its step exactly.

name: fit
description: Changes the playback speed so each sample lasts exactly as long as its event. Good for loops.

name: echo
description: Layers copies of the pattern, each later by the given time and quieter by the feedback factor.

name: echoWith
description: Layers copies of the pattern, each later by the given time and changed by the function, which gets the copy number.

name: layer
description: Plays the result of each function on top of the others, without the original pattern.
